title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
  
  
Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
  
  
Capital One has been a pioneer through our tech journey as the first large bank to go all in on the public cloud, while operating in a complex and highly regulated business environment. We have built out a large engineering organization, moved to the cloud, re-architected our applications and data platforms, and embraced machine learning at scale.
  
  
Risk Tech is responsible for transforming risk management into a real time, intelligent discipline powered by modern products and technical capabilities. Our mission is divided into two primary functional pillars: Risk Management Tech (RMT), which develops the frameworks and tools for monitoring risks, testing controls, and managing regulatory requirements; and AML and Compliance Tech (ACT), which ensures our products are delivered ethically and in strict compliance with BSA/AML regulations and global laws.
  
  
Reinforcing these pillars are our commitment to Architecture & Engineering Excellence. Our Architecture team bridges the gap between business strategy and technical execution through a customer centric, domain oriented lens, while our Engineering Excellence team empowers our talent to build better, more resilient systems every day. Together, we ensure that Risk Tech isn't just a safeguard - it’s a competitive advantage.
  
  
**Principal Associate - Software Engineering**
Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment?
  
  
At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who solve real problems and meet real customer needs.
  
  
We are seeking Full Stack Software Engineers who are passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies. As a Capital One Software Engineer, you will have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving a major transformation within Capital One.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Be part of a team to design, architect, and then deliver distributed microservices based robust,

cloud native, resilient, and highly scalable fullstack solutions for a SaaS application
  
  

* Display a strong engineering and technology background with the ability to learn quickly and go deep into our product and engineering solutions
* Utilize programming languages like, Java, Scala, Go, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS,, SQL, and Python, RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of AWS tools and services
* Promote a culture of engineering excellence and being well-managed, using opportunities to

reuse and innersource solutions where possible.
  
  

* Lead the craftsmanship, availability, resilience,and scalability of your solutions
* Collaborate with architects and product managers, and deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences for our customers

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* At least 5 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply) in one or more of the following: Java, Scala, Golang, React, Node, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
* At least 2 years of experience with one or more cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, Azure
* At least 1 year of experience with REST, Spring Boot, GraphQL, Jenkins
* At least 1 year of experience with containerization technologies

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* 6+ years of experience specifically in one or more: Java, Scala, Golang, React, Node, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
* 3+ years of experience with AWS, GCP, Azure or other cloud services
* 2+ years of experience with containerization technologies
* 2+ years of experience in front-end development
* 1+ years of experience in open source frameworks
* 1+ years of experience in Big Data, Data Security, Governance and Controls
* 1+ years of experience in Agile practices

***At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.***
No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.
  
  
For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

(COPSSC).

title: Senior Fullstack Sitecore Developer
description:
About Adactin :

Adactin is a Sydney-headquartered IT consulting and technology services company with more than 15 years of successful operations. With offices across major Australian cities and New Zealand, we continue to expand our presence across APAC and international markets.

Our expertise spans four key service pillars: Microsoft Services, AWS Cloud Engineering, AI and Quality Engineering. We help enterprise and government clients deliver complex technology modernisation and digital transformation programs.

**Sitecore Developer – Role Description**

**Location : Anywhere in India (Remote)**

**Role Responsibilities**

**The Sitecore Developer will be responsible for:**

* Rebuilding existing legacy .NET components and logic in Next.JS headless solution.
* Creating Storybook examples and ensuring maximum test coverage for all code.
* Rebuilding/migrating Sitecore customisations such as custom fields / token handling / RTE enhancements.
* Rebuilding integration logic with ACU's middleware (WS02 via REST).
* Working with existing ETL migration script to ensure Sitecore content is correctly migrated.
* Fixing any logic / UI issues for rebuilt code.
* Assisting with Sitecore AI forms-email setup / integration.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **Sitecore AI (formerly XM Cloud) experience (mandatory).**
* **Next.js (React/Typescript) development experience (mandatory).**
* Experience handling Sitecore wildcard pages using Next.js.
* Preferably familiarity with SSG / ISR / cache components.
* **CSS / Tailwind experience (mandatory).**
* Storybook experience.
* PowerShell / Sitecore PowerShell Extensions experience.
* Headless architecture experience.
* Azure DevOps experience.
* Familiarity with Azure web apps / function apps / SQL.
* Familiarity with Sitecore AI Forms / Connect / Send is a bonus.

**Scope of Work**

The rebuild/migration work includes:

* Public Website.
* Staff Site.
* Student Portal.
* 6+ Microsites.
* Integration with middleware.
* Integration with Sitecore AI Forms / Connect / Send / Content Hub.

**Deliverables**

* Code commits in git repo for all rebuilt legacy code and serialised Sitecore items.
* Storybook stories for all rebuilt components.
* Vite tests with maximum test coverage for all components + logic.
* Pull requests in Azure DevOps for all work.
* Documented logic (in Confluence) of components rebuilt from .NET to Next.js.

**Please note:**
Where it says that the skills are mandatory, please ensure that the candidate has these specific skills. Just having Sitecore XP experience is not enough; they must have experience with
**Sitecore AI/XM Cloud**
.

About the Role
  
  
Athenian Tech is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to take hands-on ownership of core areas of our AI-driven threat intelligence platform. This live, production platform ingests threat data from a wide range of external sources, enriches and scores it, and delivers curated intelligence feeds to enterprise customers over industry standard protocols. You will work closely with senior technology leadership to own production stability and data quality while helping shape architecture and process as the platform scales.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own deep hands-on platform architecture, data pipeline, enrichment, scoring and delivery.
* Ensure production reliability across production, UAT and local environments, owning monitoring, alerting, healthchecks, and acting as the escalation point for incidents.
* Maintain daily data quality of the intelligence feed including data provenance, scoring integrity, and false positive control.
* Enforce strict change management discipline including testing, rollback plans, and verification of every change.
* Evaluate and onboard new data sources into the platform (feed lifecycle management).
* Handle technical aspects of customer onboarding including access scoping, feed configuration, and integration support with enterprise SIEM and SOAR platforms.
* Keep runbooks and documentation current, and assist in interviewing and building the engineering team.
* Drive the engineering backlog, delivery cadence, and production readiness work.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering discipline with strong fundamentals in operating systems, networking, and data structures.
* 4 to 6 years of experience in backend, platform, or security engineering with hands-on responsibility for a production system.
* Strong proficiency in Python as the primary language for platform and automation work.
* Strong Linux command-line skills including managing services, cron, logs, and troubleshooting production servers.
* Hands-on database experience at production scale, ideally Elasticsearch, along with SQL basics; Redis or RabbitMQ exposure is a plus.
* Strong AWS experience with EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, and running self-hosted workloads with Docker.
* Strong reasoning and debugging ability, with clear written communication skills for runbooks and customer documentation.
* A dynamic, ownership-driven working style suited to a fast-paced startup environment.

**Preferred Skills & Nice To Have**

* Exposure to cyber security, threat intelligence, or SOC workflows including IOC lifecycle, STIX, TAXII, MISP, VirusTotal, Shodan.
* Experience with threat intelligence platforms such as OpenCTI, or integrating with enterprise SIEM and SOAR products.
* GraphQL API experience and nginx configuration knowledge.
* Prior mentoring experience or aspiration to grow into a lead role.
* AWS, Red Hat, Elastic, or security certifications (Security+, CEH) are a bonus.

Benefits & Perks
  
  

* Real ownership on a live product with paying enterprise customers.
* Fast-paced startup environment with a strong engineering and intelligence culture and short decision paths.
* Competitive salary based on experience with clear growth path to a lead role as the team scales.
* Work from the Noida office with a six-day support cadence including alternate Saturdays.

description:
Anstellung
**als Cloud-und Software-Developer bei tapdo technologies GmbH**
Wir suchen für so bald wie möglich
**Verstärkung**
für unser Team aus kreativen und physikbegeisterten IT-lern.
  
  
Unser Geschäftsfeld ist die Entwicklung von
**Cloud- und IoT-Systemen**
. Dabei betreiben wir viel Prototyping in den Bereichen Embedded Systems & Automatisierung. Wir entwickeln vor allem vernetzte Sensor- und Steuermodule, programmieren die nötige Firmware und kümmern uns um die Datenanbindung und -verarbeitung.
  
  
**Das Erwartet Dich**

* Neben einer entspannten Arbeitsatmosphäre bieten wir flexible Arbeitszeiten an, sodass sich dein Job gut mit deinem Privatleben vereinbaren lässt
* Home-Office und eine cloud-basierte Arbeitsumgebung ermöglichen Dir modernes Arbeiten an jedem von Dir bevorzugten Ort
* In unserem modernen Tapdo-Headquarter mit eigener Werkstatt im Norden von Münster setzen wir auf flache Hierarchien: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kollegen und Chefs zusammen
* Wir wünschen uns, dass Du eigenverantwortlich und motiviert in den Projekten mitarbeitest – Deine eigenen Ideen und Lösungsansätze sind hier gern gesehen.
* Zusätzliche Benefits: Gemeinsame Team-Events, kostenlose Getränke im Headquarter und Bastelabende, bei denen Du unsere Werkstatt auch für deine eigenen DIY-Projekte nutzen kannst.

**Du Passt Zu Uns, Wenn Du**

* genau so ein Technik-Nerd wie wir bist und schon als Kind deine eigenen Spiele programmiert hast,
* Informatik studiert oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung abgeschlossen hast,
* versiert in einer der folgenden Progammiersprachen bist: Typescript/Javascript, C(++), Kotlin
* Erfahrung im Betrieb und der Nutzung moderner Datenbanksysteme, z.B. PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, u.Ä., besitzt und
* bereits Applikationen im Internet, besonders in Cloud Umgebungen wie AWS, Azure oder Google Compute Cloud, bereitgestellt hast.

What if your software engineering expertise could define how the next generation of AI writes, debugs, and ships code on its own? We're looking for Senior Software Engineers in Bangalore to work at the frontier of agentic AI — building, evaluating, and improving autonomous coding systems that can reason through complex problems, execute multi-step plans, and produce production-quality software with minimal human intervention.
  
  
Bangalore is home to one of the world's most dynamic engineering talent pools, and this role is designed for senior engineers here who want to apply their deep technical skills to the most transformative technology of our time.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you're a senior engineer who's excited about agentic AI and wants to work on problems that genuinely matter, we want to hear from you.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote

* Ongoing learning exposure to state-of-the-art large language models and autonomous systems
* Potential for long-term engagement and contract extension as projects scale

title: Robotics Simulation Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
What if the physics simulations you build could teach the next generation of robots how to walk, grasp, and navigate the real world? We're looking for Robotics Simulation Engineers in Bangalore to design, build, and optimize high-fidelity physical simulations that bridge the gap between virtual environments and real-world robotic systems.
  
  
Bangalore's deep engineering talent and growing robotics ecosystem make it an ideal base for this work. You'll work at the intersection of robotics, physics, and software engineering — creating simulation pipelines that power robot learning, controls development, and hardware validation.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No corporate red tape — just meaningful, technical work on problems that matter.
  
  

* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design and implement high-fidelity robot models (URDF/MJCF) with accurate kinematics, dynamics, and contact properties
* Build and maintain simulation environments using MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and/or Gazebo
* Develop end-to-end simulation pipelines for robot training, testing, and validation
* Tune physics parameters — friction, damping, inertia, actuator models — to maximize sim-to-real transfer
* Integrate simulations with ROS2 for perception, planning, and control workflows
* Write clean, performant code in Python and/or C++ to support simulation infrastructure
* Collaborate asynchronously with robotics researchers and engineers on model accuracy and environment design
* Profile and optimize simulation performance for large-scale or parallelized runs
* Document simulation configurations, model parameters, and pipeline architecture

**Who You Are**

* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major robotics simulator: MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or Gazebo
* Proficient in Python and/or C++ in a robotics or scientific computing context
* Solid understanding of rigid-body dynamics, contact mechanics, and control theory
* Experience creating and validating robot models (URDF, MJCF, or SDF formats)
* Familiarity with ROS2 and its integration with simulation environments
* Comfortable working with simulation pipelines — from environment setup to data collection and evaluation
* Self-directed, detail-oriented, and effective when working independently
* Strong problem-solving instincts and a drive to close the sim-to-real gap

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with domain randomization, sim-to-real transfer techniques, or reinforcement learning in simulation
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated simulation (e.g., Isaac Gym, MuJoCo MJX)
* Background in legged locomotion, manipulation, or multi-body systems
* Experience with CI/CD for simulation testing and automated validation
* Knowledge of sensor simulation — cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, force/torque sensors
* Contributions to open-source robotics or simulation projects
* Graduate-level coursework or research in robotics, controls, or computational physics

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge robotics simulation projects that directly impact how robots learn and perform
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where you're most productive
* Freelance autonomy with technically challenging, meaningful work
* Collaborate with a global community of robotics and AI professionals
* Gain exposure to state-of-the-art simulation frameworks and research-grade problems
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

description:
